sampling.face_distribution: triangle-area-weighted within each face; equal count per face
sampling.edge_distribution: uniform native curve parameter including endpoints
sampling.degenerate_edges: repeat a real topological vertex; never use an origin fallback
sampling.coordinates: as stored; no alignment, scaling or rotation
sampling.cd: mean(pred-to-gt squared nearest distance) + mean(gt-to-pred squared nearest distance)

post_protocol.adapter: lossless integer-valued float connectivity to int64; native raw retained

limitations: Validation100, K=1: checkpoint/system comparison, not equal-budget architecture ablation.
raw_complete/post_input_valid allow the recorded lossless integer-valued float connectivity cast; native raw remains unchanged.
Raw grid CD and trimmed native STEP CD use different sampling and are separate metrics.
Missing/failed geometry remains in coverage denominators; numerical means use explicit computable sets.
Native solid validity uses stored tolerances; it is not an engineering precision guarantee.
